fdroid:com.terminator.app.name: Terminator
fdroid:com.terminator.app.summary: Multi-session terminal emulator with Material UI theming and root support
fdroid:com.terminator.app.description:
Terminator is a terminal emulator with multi-session support you can directly customize and control. Its main purpose is terminal emulation that can only be read by the user, suitable for daily use on Android. It does not offer a ready-made chroot/proot environment — the terminal tool infrastructure and other setup is left to you.
 Appearance 
 Material UI with full color mapping, implemented in its own color interface
 AMOLED black and dynamic (Material You) color support
 Custom RGB codes and custom CSS terminal colors for a simple/plain look
 Built-in themes: default, Solarized Dark, Gruvbox Dark, Dracula, Nord — palettes are configurable yourself, with Termcolor and CSS color support
 See the Terminator-themes repo (github.com/8dmusichannels-star/terminator-themes) for example custom themes/palettes
 Sessions 
 Multi-session support: create multiple sessions, set a default/favorite
 File-based or command-argument sessions — in command-arg sessions you specify the executable to run, in file-based sessions the shell script name/path
 Both support a login path, startup directory, and direct root session activation (without calling /system/bin/su)
 Note: if you pass a chroot/proot-like environment as an argument, the starting directory may not work — only valid for arguments that support an entry path. Chroot validity in root/proot-like environments is variable
 Purge-on-clear setting: controls whether old data left in the terminal's PTY buffer is actually wiped
 Terminal features 
 Hyperlinks: only whitelisted formats open by default; custom app schemes can be allowed via session settings, at your own risk
 OSC 32 clipboard read support for the clipboard/terminal
 SRM and local echo — note: with an IME, double characters/typing risk can occur, similar to a physical keyboard
 Kitty terminal protocol (all protocols) and Kitty terminal emulation
 Sixel image rendering, with iTerm2 inline image support
 OSC 777 and OSC 9 notifications: with phone notifications enabled, the terminal (or your own notification-based app) can notify you
 Custom or default notification sound
 Export the session as .txt, with an option to show/hide the save button
 Display, resizing and layout 
 Resize by text size, terminal width, or temporary session zoom; pinch-to-zoom toggle (on by default)
 Alpha/transparency with background support and background blur
 Fonts: monospace, sans, serif embedded, plus custom TTF/OTF fonts
 Show/hide status bar and title bar; horizontal orientation supported
 Split screen and floating screen, with a toggle to show/hide their switch buttons
 Broadcast-to-all-panes toggle: sends typed text/commands to every open split/float session at once
 Clear-all-sessions toggle: off hides the clear button on session close; on clears all sessions
 Physical keyboard and mouse support
 Keyboard 
 Soft keyboard (tap to open/close) and virtual keybar, independently toggleable, plus toggleable shortcut/keymapper buttons to map physical keys to the virtual keyboard
 Login/IME modes: default (all IMEs, incl. solid CJK button), semantically correct (may break some IMEs), old workaround for Samsung keyboard echo (may break Gboard), CJK input (default recommended)
 Seccomp support resolves operation-disallowed errors
 Supported TERM types 
NONE ($TERM left unset), xterm, xterm-color, xterm-256color (recommended, full support for vim/htop/nano etc.), screen, screen-256color, tmux, tmux-256color, xterm-kitty, vt220, vt100 (minimal, near-universal), ANSI (basic, no 256-color).
Terminator leaves shell tools/environment setup up to you, giving deep control over appearance, sessions, and keyboard behavior.

fdroid:dev.x56.verify.name: 0x56erify
fdroid:dev.x56.verify.description:
0x56erify is a minimal, offline-first checksum verification tool for Android.
Pick a file with the system document picker, compute its SHA-256 or SHA-512
checksum, and compare it against a hash you paste in (for example, one
published alongside a download) to confirm the file wasn't corrupted or
tampered with.
Features:
* Pick any file using Android's built-in Storage Access Framework picker
* Compute SHA-256 or SHA-512 checksums
* Streamed hashing: large files are never fully loaded into memory
* Copy or share the computed hash
* Paste an expected hash and get a clear MATCH / MISMATCH result
* Case-insensitive, whitespace-tolerant hash comparison
Privacy and permissions:
* All processing happens entirely on-device
* No network access, no INTERNET permission, no analytics, no ads, no accounts
* No broad storage permissions - files are accessed only through the system
 picker for the duration of the operation
* No proprietary or Google Play Services / Firebase dependencies
0x56erify is free and open source software, released under the Apache
License 2.0.

fdroid:digital.ventral.ips.name: Inter Profile Sharing
fdroid:digital.ventral.ips.summary: Easily share media and text between Android user profiles
fdroid:digital.ventral.ips.description:
This is a simple Tool allowing you to share media and text with another Android User Profile as easily as forwarding it to another App.
Android's User Profiles allow isolating Apps from each other such that users are able to keep sensitive applications separate from less trustworthy ones. No profile can access the apps, app data or files of another profile, but that also means that there's no easy way for for users of profiles to exchange information.
With this App you'll be able to select which information you'd like to share with other profiles on the same device. Notifications about the shared data will be shown in the other profiles allowing you to download, share or copy it from the profile the data is located in.
All inter-profile communications happen locally without requiring an Internet connection, the use of servers, or involvement of 3rd party services.
No Ads. No Tracking. No In-App Purchases. Free Open Source Software.

firefox-addons:3066939.name: Privacy Inspector
firefox-addons:3066939.summary: Audit cookies, storage, redirects and consent changes in the current tab, then export locally.
firefox-addons:3066939.description: Privacy Inspector is a compact local sidebar for privacy audits. It captures cookie and Set-Cookie metadata, redirect chains, selected request headers, Firefox tracking classifications, and Local and Session Storage. Cookie and storage values can be revealed per entry in the sidebar; they are held only in the open sidebar and never appear in exports, where local SHA-256 hashes detect changes instead. Every read reports whether it succeeded, so a failed read is never shown as an empty result. Consent snapshots compare added, changed and deleted state. Freeze preserves an immutable audit snapshot across tab switches and navigation. Pause applies per tab and Off globally. Recording runs only while the sidebar or connected Hub is active, with a separate audit per tab. Reports are created only on user action: a Word document with real tables, TXT or Markdown, with tables of cookies, requests and Web Storage split into before and after consent, in English or German, optionally with URL query values masked — or copied to the clipboard as a table. Everything stays local: no server, telemetry or data sharing.

Forcing yourself to work on long period of time is ineffective. Rest is as important as work / study. Why? Because rest is a crucial time where you:
- store what you have learned in your head, and where

Automate it with AppleScript on MacOS and Apple Shortcut on iOS
SEE YOUR SESSIONS ON APPLE CALENDAR WITH ONE WAY SYNC.

REVIEW YOUR SESSIONS
Are you spending more time on a task than it's worth? Session keep you mindful by tracking your work and ask what you have learned after Session has ended.

- Scanning and text recognition (OCR) run locally on your iPhone.
- No account, no sign-up, no cloud storage.
- Your documents stay on your device unless you share them yourself.
- App Lock keeps your library behind Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode.

- Scan multi-page documents into one PDF, or import PDFs and images from Files.
- Organize documents into folders and search the text inside every scan.
- Sign documents with your finger.
- Redact sensitive info — black boxes are burned permanently into the PDF.
- Merge, compress and reorder pages.
- Share to Files, Mail, Messages or any app you like.
START FREE, THEN CHOOSE WHAT FITS
Keep up to 10 documents free — no account, no sign-up. When you need unlimited documents and the full toolkit, choose what suits you:
- A monthly plan.
- A yearly plan.
- A one-time lifetime purchase if you'd rather own it for good.
Prices are shown clearly in the app before you commit. Some tools require FairScan Pro.
HONEST NOTE
FairScan is a productivity and document tool. It is not a substitute for professional, legal, or medical advice, and automatic text recognition may not be perfect — always double-check important documents.
SUPPORT

BookAloud is a text to speech reader that turns PDFs, EPUBs, Word documents, and even printed pages into audiobooks you can listen to anywhere — no internet required. Think of it as an app that reads to me: pick a voice, import a document, and BookAloud starts reading aloud immediately, using powerful on-device speech technology so you can learn, study, and get things done hands-free.
Whether you call it a read aloud app, a voice reader, or simply a book reader, BookAloud does one thing very well: it turns text into natural-sounding speech so you can listen to books, articles, reports, and scanned pages instead of straining your eyes to read them. It's built for commuters, students, multitaskers, people who find long reading sessions tiring, and anyone who'd rather listen to books than stare at a screen.
--- FREE FEATURES ---
• Convert up to 3 documents per day (up to 20 pages each) — no account needed
• PDF and EPUB import
• All voices in 50+ languages, no restrictions on which ones you can use
• Read Along view — text highlights word by word as the voice reader speaks
• Lock screen and background audio playback
• Smart PDF cleaning — strips headers, footers, and repeated page numbers
• Sleep timer, so BookAloud stops reading aloud after a set time
• Bookmarks to save your place and pick up where you left off
• Adjustable playback speed
• Document queue, to line up several books and listen back to back
• Camera scan for printed books, recognized on-device — nothing uploaded
--- BOOKALOUD PRO ---
Upgrade to BookAloud Pro to unlock the full audiobook experience:
• Unlimited daily conversions — turn as many documents into audiobooks as you want, any day
• No page limits — listen to entire books cover to cover, not just the first 20 pages
• Word document (.docx) import, on top of PDF and EPUB
• Variable playback speed up to 2.5x, for listening faster without losing clarity
• Export as an audio file (.m4a) so you can keep or share the finished audiobook
--- HOW IT WORKS ---
1. Choose a voice and language from BookAloud's built-in voice reader
2. Import a PDF, EPUB, or Word document, or scan a printed page with your camera
3. BookAloud converts the text and starts reading aloud right away
4. Keep listening anywhere — background audio and lock screen controls mean the reading never has to stop
--- SMART PDF CLEANING ---
PDFs are full of clutter a document was never meant to be read aloud with — running headers, footers, and page numbers repeating on every page. BookAloud's smart cleaning removes that clutter automatically, so the text to speech engine reads only the content that matters.
--- READ ALONG VIEW ---
While BookAloud reads aloud, the Read Along view highlights and auto-scrolls to the exact word being spoken — useful for language learning, proofreading, or simply staying focused. You can scroll ahead or back at any time without losing your place.
--- WHO USES BOOKALOUD ---
People use BookAloud as a book reader for their commute, to get through work documents hands-free, to listen to books while exercising, to have a chapter read to me before sleep with the sleep timer, and as a study tool for reading textbooks aloud while following along.
